cells.note: The Bank of Uganda runs the RTGS and the Automated Clearing House, in service until an upgrade closure of 5 to 9 November 2026 (UGA-002); an interbank clearing system the central bank manages answers question 3. The East African Payment System is regional and does not answer question 4.
